rules.title: Local Images with Query Strings (Breaking change)

rules.rollback_hint: Return to the previous release of the library.
rules.concern: A local image source with a query string needs images.localPatterns.search.

mapping.from: a local image src with a query string

rules.rollback_hint: Return to the previous release of the library.

rules.title: Local IP Restriction (Breaking change)

rules.verify_hint: Load the affected page or run the build, and confirm the new behaviour.
rules.rollback_hint: Return to the previous release of the library.
rules.concern: Optimising local IP image sources is restricted.

mapping.from: an image src on a local IP
mapping.to: images.localPatterns or images.dangerouslyAllowLocalIP when that is intended
